lessons.title: Your First Picture Sudoku

play.targetObjective: Fill the 4×4 grid so every row, column and box has each picture once.
stepByStep: Count the empty cells in each row, column and box.
Stop at one with a single empty cell.
Say which number is missing, and put it in.
play.kidTip: Find the row, column or box with just one empty cell. The missing number goes there.
play.audioPrompt: Put each picture once in every row, column and box.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every puzzle needs full house and nothing harder, so the technique is practised, not luck.

lessons.title: Look at the Box

stepByStep: Choose a number that appears often.
Look at a box that does not have it yet.
Follow the rows and columns that already have it. One cell is left.
play.kidTip: Pick a number. Follow its rows and columns into a box. The one cell they do not cross is where it goes.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every puzzle needs hidden single box and nothing harder, so the technique is practised, not luck.

lessons.title: Naked Pair

lessons.title: Hidden Pair
